limitations: Initial-only and self-review share generation and are paired endpoints, not independent runs.
Do not sum both endpoint cumulative costs as batch spending; count each generation once.
Historical P21-feedback controls are nonconcurrent; descriptive comparisons only.
Repair metrics are not applicable to initial-only. Missing scores are not zero findings.
All failures remain in the planned denominator; no successful retry substitution.
Historical conformance scores use current accepted fixed-artifact revalidation; original scores remain unchanged in source evidence. Other historical metrics retain their original run measurements.

Metric 3 shows original and current validator status separately. A successful reassessment does not erase an original technical failure; elapsed time and cost refer to original model workflows and exclude post-hoc host revalidation.
Auxiliary checks cover selected conditional derivations, not comprehensive clinical correctness. Planned-check coverage is not an adjudicated applicable-check denominator.
API costs are telemetry estimates, not invoices. Token totals retain provider cache/reasoning buckets; cross-provider billing semantics are not independently reconciled.
DeepSeek was added later: two independent generation sessions supply three endpoints. This is an exploratory extension, not a prespecified main-study model.
DeepSeek telemetry costs use declared peak rates; actual off-peak billing may be lower. Readiness costs are excluded. The official model alias is mutable.

Temperature 0.2, 0.6 and 1.0 each contribute one selected independent initial-only result. Execution order was 1.0, 0.2, then 0.6. Descriptive sensitivity observations only; no causal or significance claims.

The title helper is disabled for all new temperature endpoints. Historical default-setting endpoints are nonconcurrent contextual controls. New temperature 1.0 is the matched-setting reference within this batch.
Gemini preview is a mutable provider endpoint. Serialized temperature acceptance does not verify server-side sampling internals.

Temperature 0.6 uses a user-authorized fresh replacement after an API spending-cap interruption. The interrupted attempt is excluded from this results table; its raw evidence remains private. Reported cost and time cover selected attempts only, not total campaign spending. There were no automatic generation retries.
Temperature endpoints have no repair phase. Cost estimates exclude nonclinical qualification calls and are not invoices. P21 conformance does not establish clinical derivation correctness.

GPT-OSS-20B contributes one independent workflow per condition. Its three initial generations are not paired; historical initial-only/self-review shared-generation endpoints have a different dependence structure.

DeepInfra settings are fixed at temperature 1.0, medium reasoning and 16,384 maximum response tokens. The title helper is disabled and only the declared provider API is reachable. Hosted weights and server implementation are not independently pinned.
One repetition per condition supports descriptive feasibility observations only. No temperature or causal feedback/model-size claims are supported.
All three planned GPT-OSS-20B conditions remain in the denominator, including failures and unscheduled conditions if execution stops. No automatic retries. Missing scores are unavailable, not zero.
API cost estimates exclude technical qualification and are not invoices. The GPT-OSS conditions independently incur their own generation and repair costs.

The selected GPT-OSS batch follows a documented file-tool environment amendment: a hash-pinned ripgrep executable is provisioned before generation. An earlier unqualified batch with glob dependency errors remains private and is excluded from the results table; its spending is not included in selected-workflow costs.

Where native tool telemetry is null for a normal turn, a zero tool count is reported only if exported current-turn messages independently contain no tool parts. Raw telemetry is preserved and each such interpretation is recorded.

GPT-OSS-120B contributes one independent workflow per condition. Its three initial generations are not paired; historical initial-only/self-review shared-generation endpoints have a different dependence structure.

DeepInfra settings are fixed at temperature 1.0, medium reasoning and 16,384 maximum response tokens. The title helper is disabled and only the declared provider API is reachable. Hosted weights and server implementation are not independently pinned.
One repetition per condition supports descriptive feasibility observations only. No temperature or causal feedback/model-size claims are supported.
All three planned GPT-OSS-120B conditions remain in the denominator, including failures and unscheduled conditions if execution stops. No automatic retries. Missing scores are unavailable, not zero.
API cost estimates exclude technical qualification and are not invoices. The GPT-OSS conditions independently incur their own generation and repair costs.

GPT-OSS-120B uses the same qualified hash-pinned ripgrep support as the selected GPT-OSS-20B batch. Nonclinical readiness and transport evidence are verified before each workflow. Qualification costs are excluded from clinical workflow costs.

Where native tool telemetry is null for a normal turn, a zero tool count is reported only if exported current-turn messages independently contain no tool parts. Raw telemetry is preserved and each such interpretation is recorded.

Llama 4 Scout contributes one independent workflow per condition. Its three initial generations are not paired; historical initial-only/self-review shared-generation endpoints have a different dependence structure.

DeepInfra settings are fixed at temperature 1.0, no reasoning-effort parameter and 16,384 maximum response tokens. The title helper is disabled and only the declared provider API is reachable. Hosted weights and server implementation are not independently pinned.
One repetition per condition supports descriptive feasibility observations only. No temperature or causal feedback/model-size claims are supported.
All three planned Llama 4 Scout conditions remain in the denominator, including failures and unscheduled conditions if execution stops. No automatic retries. Missing scores are unavailable, not zero.
API cost estimates exclude technical qualification and are not invoices. The Llama conditions independently incur their own generation and repair costs.

Llama 4 Scout uses qualified hash-pinned ripgrep support. The first nonclinical readiness attempt failed with empty tool arguments; a second diagnostic uses explicit synthetic tool parameters. All attempts are retained; study prompts are unchanged. Qualification costs are excluded from clinical workflow costs.

Where native tool telemetry is null for a normal turn, a zero tool count is reported only if exported current-turn messages independently contain no tool parts. Raw telemetry is preserved and each such interpretation is recorded.
The three added metrics are retrospective exploratory analyses defined after seeing pilot outcomes; the original sixteen metrics, scores and records are preserved.

Delivery and variable coverage assess retained evaluated snapshots, including a snapshot from a failed controller where available. They do not establish task success, correct records, correct values, metadata conformance or reproducibility.

Failure-stage indicators are nonexclusive and include downstream consequences. Missing datasets/Define-XML are delivery failures, not proof of a particular failed export command. Blocked rebuild/P21 stages are distinguished from direct failures.

Input/code failures require direct current-phase tool execution evidence. No observed failure is not proof of a stage passing; unclassified tool errors and controller/provider failures remain separate. Recovered tool failures remain counted in that phase.

Distribution denominators are table endpoints, not independent trials: some historical initial-only and self-review endpoints share an initial generation; model settings and historical environments differ. Do not use pooled counts for causal or inferential comparisons.
P21 failure classification uses original evaluation receipts, while original metric 3 can show later reassessment. These answer different questions and must not be conflated.

analysis_provenance.policy: Only expose original versus current validation status; counts, costs, controller status and source files unchanged.

definitions.dataset_delivery: Readable expected lowercase XPT files / 13; absent or unreadable files do not count. Extra datasets do not increase numerator.
definitions.variable_coverage: Sum of expected exact-case dataset-variable names with correct Numeric/Character XPT storage class / 531. Missing datasets contribute zero. Unreadable schemas make the exact overall rate unavailable. Length, format, values and row completeness are not assessed.
definitions.failure_stages: Nonexclusive observed phase-level stage indicators. Failed includes missing required delivery; blocked means known missing prerequisites. Counts are endpoints, not error-event counts. No failure observed does not prove successful execution. Original P21 execution is used; reassessment never erases original failure. Usable reports with findings do not count as validator execution failures.
